question: Does the second local LRU demand occur before, at, or after completion of the first removed item's direct repair, and how does the native stock/backorder ledger respond at the boundary?

accepted_controls.observed_boundary: repair_before_demand; repaired physical ID1 is issued from stock without a backorder
demand_before_repair; backorder clears when repaired physical ID1 returns

candidate_child.sole_authored_delta: ItemRepair record 1 TEACH-LRU-01/BASE-01 DIRPT changes from 1 hour to a value targeting the second demand's repair-completion boundary; all other authored cells and the seed remain fixed
candidate_child.estimate_origin: 22.0 minus the six-decimal printed first repair start 9.921933; native event times are printed with limited precision, so this estimate does not establish an exact tie
candidate_child.exact_tie_gate: An at-boundary result requires native raw evidence that independently identifies equal event times at sufficient precision and resolves ordering. If equality or ordering is ambiguous, retain a diagnostic only and do not claim an exact-tie rule.

required_prelaunch_review: Independently reread manual pages for direct item repair, local stock and backorders; verify accepted parent controls and raw seals without rerunning them.
Check whether this fixed seed, frozen model and a single DIRPT delta can produce a testable exact-time contrast. Reject an unobservable exact tie before native launch.
Freeze a new source version, exact parameter and SHA, runner and validator after contract approval; use one new unique run path and the existing serial SSH mutex and protected GUI identity.
native_acceptance_gate: Import/export must preserve all authored row-containing tables; converter must produce no errors and an interpretable warning set; SXO, event log and selected report must be valid.
Read exact child event ordering and physical item identities from original event logs; reconcile every stock and backorder transition and all half-hour system and aggregate stock bins.
Preserve invocation, source before/after, all raw and failed byte hashes; obtain separately written independent read-only replay and bounded sign-off before publication.
limits: No exact-tie, FIFO, general threshold, post-fit installed physical ID, other seed, GUI, cross-engine or full E05/Issue #18 claim before native evidence and independent review. K01/K08 capture blockers and I07 opening-stock-three exclusion remain unchanged.
